description: List the title's localization KEYS with their text in the DEFAULT language, plus the configured locales. Call it before writing any user-visible string so you reuse an existing key instead of inventing a second one for the same label. Filter with "prefix" ("shop.", "quest."); long tables are truncated and say so. The client resolves text as t(x) = player's table -> fallback table -> x itself, which is why a plain literal still renders — a literal is simply a key with no translation.
name: get_localization_keys
title: Get localization keys
